# Morale execution
Commissars and officers can execute an ally for a [color=#a4885c]team-wide buff[/color]. It's a harsh but powerful mechanic of WH14K team combat.
## How it works - An officer applies the execution ability to an ally within arm's reach. - The target dies — execution knows no mercy and ignores armor. - After the execution the whole team in a large radius gets a buff for several minutes: fighters move faster, hit harder and take less damage themselves. - The recharge is very long — you'll get one or two uses per phase.
## Who can execute - Officers with special permission can execute: commissar, colonel, sergeant. - By default only a psyker can be the target — it's their lawful fate in the Imperium. - Some roles can execute [color=#a4885c]any ally[/color] — a coward, a heretic turncoat, a simply useless fighter.
## When to use it - Before the final wave or a big push — a several-minute buff is worth losing one fighter. - On a psyker who's piled up too much warp instability — execution saves the team from a warp catastrophe. - Don't waste it: the recharge is very long, you can hand out the buff only a few times per round.
